title: Uni-Fuels Reports Audited FY2025 Results with 70% Revenue Growth and Expanding Global Operations
summary: Gross profit rose 47% to $4.7M and working capital reached $10.1M, helping fund higher trading volumes. Uni-Fuels sees 2026 revenue of $310M-$330M.
body_markdown:
On the day this news was published, **UFG** gained **4.73%** , reflecting a moderate positive market reaction. Argus tracked a peak move of **+2.1%** during that session. Argus tracked a trough of **-5.2%** from its starting point during tracking. Our momentum scanner triggered **4 alerts** that day, indicating moderate trading interest and price volatility. This price movement added approximately **$1M** to the company's valuation, bringing the market cap to **$31.82M** at that time.
